llm_analysis.reasoning: Detection, segmentation, depth, dataset building and edge optimisation are genuinely backed, but 3D tracking, thermal fusion and multi-sensor data are the headline duties and have no evidence. It is a stretch role you could grow into rather than a clean match; apply only if willing to be screened out on tracking, and note the 'could be subject to U.S. citizen' eligibility line.
